target.outcome: All-cancer mortality (ICD-10 C00–C97) from Brazil's SIM individual death records
target.effect_scale: Odds ratio per 10 µg/m3 increase in lag 0–2 PM2.5

coverage.notes: No historical individual SIM records for 2000–2019 were retrieved. The official API query returned 2025 records despite ano=2019, and the historical archive timed out.

blockers: Required public 2000–2019 individual-level Brazilian SIM mortality records were not retrieved. The current official API returned 2025 data despite a 2019 query and exposes no historical-period parameter; the official historical archive request timed out with zero bytes.
Without death dates and residential municipality for the target period, valid time-stratified case-crossover strata and municipality-specific exposure assignment cannot be constructed.
